claims: Alex Vesia is a pitcher for the Los Angeles Dodgers.
Alex Vesia and Kayla's newborn daughter Sterling passed away on October 26, 2025.
Sterling passed away due to complications from a large hematoma.
Sterling's death caused Alex Vesia to miss the World Series.
Alex Vesia and Kayla shared their loss on Instagram.
Players from the Los Angeles Dodgers wore Alex Vesia's #51 on their caps as a tribute.
Players from the Toronto Blue Jays wore Alex Vesia's #51 on their caps as a tribute.
Alex Vesia returned to the mound for the 2026 season.
Alex Vesia and Kayla started therapy to cope with their loss.
Alex Vesia stated the Los Angeles Dodgers team served as light during their darkness
